name: Gaze of Eternity
text:
This palm-sized religious symbol of Yig is an hourglass set to time for exactly 8 minutes. A serpent bearing a crescent moon and studded with eight jewels wraps around the curvature of the glass, acting as a frame. The Gaze of Eternity grants you a +2 item bonus to Religion checks related to Yig. It has the following activations.

---
Activate—See Those Beyond 2 (concentrate, manipulate)

Frequency once per day

---
Effect You cast Spirit Sense

---
Activate—See Those Present 2 (concentrate, manipulate)

Frequency once per day

---
Effect You cast Status at 4th rank.
